a4_microSySTEM_Barrier.presenceSensor: Returns true if an obstacle is detected in front of the sensor and false otherwise
a4_microSySTEM_Barrier.rgb: Sets the RGB LED using red, green and blue channel values
a4_microSySTEM_Barrier.rgb|param|blue: Blue channel value between 0 and 255, eg: 255
a4_microSySTEM_Barrier.rgb|param|green: Green channel value between 0 and 255, eg: 255
a4_microSySTEM_Barrier.rgb|param|red: Red channel value between 0 and 255, eg: 255
a4_microSySTEM_Barrier.setRingColor: Turns on the LED in the selected color
a4_microSySTEM_Barrier.barrier: Opens or closes the barrier using the predefined servo positions
a4_microSySTEM_Barrier.barrier|param|act: Open sets the servo to 115 degrees and close sets it to 5 degrees
a4_microSySTEM_Barrier.setServoAngle: Sets the servomotor angle used to control the barrier
